name: Bharti Airtel
about: Bharti Airtel Limited is a leading global telecommunications company. Airtel provides a comprehensive range of services, including mobile voice and data, broadband, digital TV, and enterprise solutions across India, South Asia, Africa, and beyond. With operations in over 50 countries and a network spanning 365,000+ RKMs, Airtel is a top 3 global mobile service provider by subscribers. The company’s diverse offerings include mobile services, tower infrastructure, home broadband, and digital TV, supported by strategically located submarine cables and satellite networks. Airtel is dedicated to enhancing digital service delivery and ensuring superior end-user experiences globally.
